description: Read your ClickUp workspace from the current app.clickup.com tab: the signed-in user, workspaces and members, spaces, folders, lists, goals and custom fields. Uses your own logged-in ClickUp session.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated ClickUp user including name, email, timezone, and avatar.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get detailed information about a ClickUp workspace including name, owner, plan, and member count. If no workspace_id is provided, returns the current workspace.

tools.name: get_workspace_members
tools.description: List all members in a ClickUp workspace including their name, email, role, and avatar. If no workspace_id is provided, uses the current workspace.

tools.name: get_spaces
tools.description: List all spaces in a ClickUp workspace. Spaces are top-level containers for organizing work. Returns space name, color, privacy, and archive status. By default excludes archived spaces.

tools.name: get_space
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific ClickUp space by its ID. Returns space name, color, privacy, features, and statuses.

tools.name: get_folders
tools.description: List all folders in a ClickUp space. Folders organize lists within a space. By default excludes archived folders.

tools.name: get_folder
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific ClickUp folder by its ID. Returns folder name, order, archive status, and parent space.

tools.name: get_lists
tools.description: List all lists in a ClickUp folder. Lists contain tasks and are the primary work containers. By default excludes archived lists.

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific ClickUp list by its ID. Returns list name, order, archive status, dates, and parent folder/space.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.description: List all goals in a ClickUp workspace. Goals track high-level objectives and can contain key results. Returns goal name, description, completion percentage, and owner.

tools.name: get_custom_fields
tools.description: List all custom fields defined in a ClickUp workspace. Custom fields add structured data to tasks (text, number, dropdown, checkbox, date, email, URL, etc.).
